summary_hint: P&L / balance sheet for <business_legal_name>, <period_start>–<period_end_or_as_of_date> (<accounting_basis>): total revenue <total_revenue>, net income <net_income_or_loss>; total assets <total_assets>, equity <owner_or_shareholder_equity>; prepared by <prepared_by>.

typed_core.name: business_legal_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose business; match to tax returns / K-1

typed_core.name: statement_type
typed_core.why: disambiguator — P&L only vs balance sheet only vs combined; changes which figures are present

typed_core.name: period_start
typed_core.why: identity — the P&L coverage period start

typed_core.name: period_end_or_as_of_date
typed_core.why: identity/recency — P&L period end (and balance-sheet as-of date)
typed_core.prompt_hint: A P&L states a period end; a balance sheet states a single as-of date — do not confuse with period_start

typed_core.name: accounting_basis
typed_core.why: disambiguator for the income figures — cash vs accrual changes the IN-12 analysis
typed_core.prompt_hint: Distinguish cash vs accrual basis; it materially changes the income read

typed_core.name: prepared_by
typed_core.why: CORE — self-prepared vs CPA; weighs reliability

typed_core.name: preparer_relationship
typed_core.why: disambiguator for prepared_by — internal vs external preparer

typed_core.name: net_income_or_loss
typed_core.why: IN-12 — the key self-employment qualifying-income base
typed_core.prompt_hint: The KEY figure for IN-12; do not compute it if unprinted, leave null

typed_core.name: owner_or_shareholder_equity
typed_core.why: processor — net worth of the business

typed_core.name: management_certification
typed_core.why: processor — whether management attested to the figures

nested_lists.name: financial_line_items
nested_lists.shape_reason: the document has several genuinely repeating groups (revenue lines, COGS, operating expenses, other income/expense, depreciation & non-recurring items, current assets, fixed/other assets, current liabilities, short/long-term debt). Item count is moderate (~20–50), so flat rows stay well under the 16,384-token ceiling

fields.name: section
fields.why: IN-12 — tags the group so the add-back lines (depreciation, amortization) IN-12 needs are addressable

fields.name: source
fields.why: provenance — the row the value came from

rejected.name: form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: a P&L/balance sheet is not a standardized form

rejected.name: document_issue_date, effective_date, expiration_date
rejected.reason: duplicate the statement period; a P&L does not expire

rejected.name: party_names, party_addresses
rejected.reason: the business is covered by business_legal_name

rejected.name: property_address, loan_number, account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not on a P&L/balance sheet; no consumer

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: the certification block (signer_name_title + signature_and_date) covers the one execution that matters; not notarized

rejected.name: comparative_periods
rejected.reason: prior-period columns land as extra line items; no rule addresses them

rejected.name: revenue_line_items, cost_of_goods_sold_line_items, operating_expense_line_items, other_income_and_expense, depreciation_amortization_and_nonrecurring_items, current_asset_line_items, fixed_and_other_assets, current_liability_line_items, short_and_long_term_debt
rejected.reason: rolled into the single financial_line_items nested list (one-list budget)

rejected.name: accounts_receivable, inventory, accounts_payable
rejected.reason: individual balance-sheet lines; captured in the nested list

encoding_variations: statement_type — 'Profit & Loss', 'Income Statement', 'Statement of Operations', 'Balance Sheet', or a combined package; no enum coercer, degrade to str
accounting_basis — 'Cash Basis', 'Accrual Basis', 'Modified Cash'; degrade to str; changes IN-12 handling
period vs as-of — a P&L states a period; a balance sheet states a single as-of date; period_end_or_as_of_date must not be confused with period_start
negatives — losses shown as (12,345) or -12,345; $/commas present (parsed by the Decimal coercer)
depreciation/amortization — may appear inside operating expenses or as a separate add-back section; capture with its section tag

open_questions.q: One combined nested list vs several — the document naturally has ~9 repeating groups
options: one flat financial_line_items with a section tag
separate lists per group (heavy plumbing, ~5 sites each)
open_questions.recommendation: (a) one flat financial_line_items — stays within the one-list budget and keeps IN-12 add-backs addressable

open_questions.q: Depreciation add-backs as scalars — IN-12 depends on depreciation/amortization add-backs
options: leave them as tagged rows in the nested list
promote total_depreciation_amortization to a typed scalar
open_questions.recommendation: (a) leave them as tagged rows; promote a scalar only if the calculator wants a single number

open_questions.q: Rule-floor derivability — IN-12's how_engine_checks names 'a dedicated Priya-validated calculator' over the tax documents, not specific P&L fields
options: the P&L chain above is the reasonable floor
confirm the calculator's exact input list
open_questions.recommendation: the P&L chain is the reasonable floor; confirm the calculator's exact input list

notes: Existing extractor is P&L-only; the spec keeps business_legal_name, period_start, period_end_or_as_of_date, total_revenue, total_operating_expenses, net_income_or_loss and ADDS gross_profit, operating_income, accounting_basis, statement_type, the balance-sheet totals, and the depreciation add-back lines.
Capture depreciation and amortization line items verbatim — they are IN-12 add-backs; if they land only in the catch-all they are discarded at the snapshot boundary and the add-back is lost.

No new _PII_FIELDS registration proposed; if the statement prints the owner's SSN or a full business bank-account number, promote it to a named typed field rather than leaving it in the unmasked catch-all.
Ambiguity: issuer_name and prepared_by are tagged 'CORE' with no explicit reason_class; both set to processor (reliability/independence weighting) as best guess; flagged.
